content: Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of isradipine by inhibiting the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of istradefylline by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Cobicistat also increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of istradefylline via CYP3A4 inhibition. Therapy modification and close monitoring are advised. Istradefylline increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of cobicistat by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. In clinical trials, istradefylline at a dose of 40 mg/day increased the peak plasma levels and area under the curve (AUC) of CYP3A4 substrates. This effect was not observed with a 20 mg/day dose. Dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates should be considered. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ivacaftor by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. The ivacaftor dose should be reduced when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Refer to specific ivacaftor-containing product guidelines for precise dosage adjustments. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ivacaftor by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. The ivacaftor dose should be reduced when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Refer to specific ivacaftor-containing product guidelines for precise dosage adjustments. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ixabepilone by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Cobicistat and ketoconazole mutually increase each other's plasma concentrations by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Specific dosage recommendations for ketoconazole when coadministered with cobicistat are not available. Darunavir decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ketamine by inducing CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration of lacosamide by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Consider reducing the lacosamide dose when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lansoprazole by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lapatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Lenacapavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of cobicistat by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Lenacapavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of darunavir by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Lenacapavir, as a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, may increase the plasma concentration of CYP3A4 substrates initiated within nine months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir. This may elevate the risk of adverse reactions associated with CYP3A4 substrates. Letermovir increases the plasma concentration of darunavir by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration of letermovir by reducing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of levamlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors increases systemic exposure to amlodipine and may necessitate dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema to determine the need for dose adjustment. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of levamlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A inhibitors increases systemic exposure to amlodipine and may necessitate dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema to determine the need for dose adjustment. Cobicistat and levoketoconazole mutually increase each other's plasma concentrations by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Specific dosage recommendations for ketoconazole when coadministered with cobicistat are not available. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of levomilnacipran by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Do not exceed 80 mg/day of levomilnacipran when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase plasma hormone concentrations. The use of a nonhormonal contraceptive is recommended. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration of lidocaine by reducing its metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lidocaine by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Clinical monitoring is recommended when coadministered with antiarrhythmics. Darunavir decreases the pharmacological effects of linagliptin through mechanisms other than CYP3A4. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of linagliptin by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Cobicistat increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of losartan by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir decreases the pharmacological effects of liraglutide through mechanisms other than CYP3A4. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Reports of hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance with protease inhibitors have been noted. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lofexidine by inhibiting CYP2D6-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Concomitant use with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors may increase lofexidine plasma levels. Monitor for symptoms of orthostasis and bradycardia, and consider dose reduction. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of lopinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of loratadine by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of losartan by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor the patient closely. Darunavir increases the plasma concentration of lumacaftor/ivacaftor by inhibiting CYP3A4-mediated metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended.
